title: Hard Constraints, Smooth Gradients: Learning Feasible Inventory Policies via Differentiable Projection
abstract: arXiv:2608.02343v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many operational problems are constrained sequential decision processes with combinatorial action spaces and interdependent constraints. Mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs) handle such constraints flexibly but scale poorly in stochastic environments. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) promises scalable decision rules, but existing methods either penalize constraints rather than enforce them, or rely on feasibility mechanisms that break down once constraints interact. We bridge this gap by embedding a differentiable optimization module inside the policy: a neural network proposes continuous action targets, a quadratic program projects them onto the relaxed feasible set, and a dual-informed integer mapping restores integrality while preserving feasibility. Given a differentiable simulator, the policy trains end-to-end from sampled trajectories using pathwise gradients, while handling hard constraints with similar flexibility to MILPs.

translated_title: 硬约束，平滑梯度：通过可微投影学习可行的库存策略
translated_abstract: 许多运营问题是具有组合动作空间和相互依赖约束的受约束序贯决策过程。混合整数线性规划（MILP）可以灵活处理这类约束，但在随机环境中扩展性较差。深度强化学习（DRL）有望提供可扩展的决策规则，但现有方法要么对约束进行惩罚而非强制执行，要么依赖的可行性机制在约束相互作用时便会失效。我们通过在策略内部嵌入一个可微优化模块来弥合这一差距：神经网络提出连续动作目标，二次规划将其投影到松弛可行集上，而基于对偶信息的整数映射在保持可行性的同时恢复整数性。在给定可微模拟器的情况下，该策略利用路径梯度从采样轨迹中进行端到端训练，同时能够以与MILP相似的灵活性处理硬约束。
tldr: 该论文在强化学习策略中嵌入可微优化模块（神经网络提出连续动作目标、二次规划投影保证可行性、对偶信息整数映射恢复整数性），实现了端到端训练并严格满足硬约束的库存决策策略。
en_tdlr: This paper embeds a differentiable optimization module into the RL policy—where a neural network proposes continuous actions, a quadratic program projects them onto the feasible set, and a dual-informed integer mapping restores integrality—enabling end-to-end training while strictly enforcing hard constraints for inventory decision-making.
